title: Airtable Team to self-hosted Teable
summary: Teable is the closest thing to Airtable anyone has built. It is also the youngest, and that cuts both ways.

you_lose: Airtable's automations, scripting block and extension marketplace
A decade of stability; Teable is moving fast and breaking things is part of that
you_gain: A grid that genuinely feels like Airtable rather than a spreadsheet pretending
Real Postgres underneath, with the tables queryable directly
Free seats at a tier where Airtable charges $20 each

caveats: Teable is the youngest project on this site. Pin a version, read the release notes, and do not upgrade on a Friday.
Its licence is not one GitHub recognises automatically. Check the repository before building anything commercial on it.
If you want the mature option in this category, read the NocoDB and Baserow comparisons instead — both are older and calmer.
